title.narrative: Fostering Security Sector Institutions Compliance with Human Rights Standards

description.narrative: The overall impact objective of the action is to build CSOs driven civiliansecurity institutions relations with an aim to forge institutionalized and strengthened accountability that will enhance respect of human dignity and adherence to human rights standards. This objective aims to influence authorities to implement through various means including the adoption of legislative, administrative and judicial measures that will enable security sectorcivilian relations and assist the security sector institutions to refrain from inhuman treatment and uphold rule of law.
